answers.core: This behavior is directly related to how `AtlasTexture` is rendered.
answers.workaround:
It can be partially worked around by rotating the node that displays the texture, but this introduces side effects on layout, offsets, and animation flow.
For projects that rely heavily on atlas-based animations, this workaround becomes repetitive and error-prone.

title: Add support for rotated regions in AtlasTexture
